Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and dignitaries. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JACOB, a frail but determined man. He is escorted to a podium, where a plaque awaits him.

OFFICIAL
Ladies And Gentlemen, It Is Our Privilege To Present The World Record For Oldest Human To Ever Live. Please Welcome The One And Only JACOB.

The room erupts in applause as Jacob takes the stage. He is handed the plaque, and with a hint of a smile, he accepts it.

CUT TO:

INT. JACOB'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jacob lies in bed, the plaque from earlier sitting on his nightstand. He gazes at it, a mix of emotions on his face. Suddenly, his eyes wander to a dusty old book on his shelf. He picks it up, blowing off the dust.

JACOB
(whispering to himself)
Quantum Immortality...

As he reads the words, his expression changes. His eyes widen, and his face contorts in a mixture of fear and confusion.

CUT TO:

INT. JACOB'S MIND - NIGHT

Jacob's mind begins to unravel. He sees himself as a young man, browsing the internet on his computer. He comes across a forum discussing Quantum Immortality.

JACOB (V.O.)
Quantum Immortality... The Theory That Our Universe Is A Simulation Created By A More Advanced Civilization. The Idea That We Are Trapped In A Never-Ending Loop Of Reality, With Every Decision Creating A New Branch Of Existence.

As Jacob delves deeper into the theory, his mind becomes a maelstrom of thoughts and emotions. He sees himself making different choices, living different lives. The weight of his years bears down on him, and he feels the crushing pressure of an infinite existence.

CUT TO:

INT. JACOB'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jacob's body begins to shake. He screams, his voice hoarse and raw. The plaque on his nightstand shatters, the pieces scattering across the floor.

JACOB
(whispering, his voice barely audible)
I... I don't want to live forever. I don't want to be trapped in this never-ending cycle.

The camera zooms in on Jacob's face, his eyes wild and unfocused. He is consumed by the weight of his own existence.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. JACOB'S HOUSE - NIGHT

The camera pans across the quiet neighborhood, the stars twinkling above. The sound of Jacob's screams echoes through the night, a haunting reminder of the fragility of the human mind.

FADE TO BLACK.
